e.title: Amanat 天气风险矿工与 WASM 评分模块：网络自报的 verified: true 从外部无法核对，于是改为交付一份任何人用 Node 就能验的 Ed25519 签名；并逐条把「文档说的」与「实测到的」差量写出来
e.title_en: The Amanat weather-risk miner and WASM scoring module: because the network’s own verified: true cannot be checked from outside, it ships an Ed25519 signature anyone can verify with Node instead — and writes out the measured gap between what the docs say and what the network actually does
e.title_hk: Amanat 天氣風險礦工與 WASM 評分模組：網絡自報的 verified: true 從外部無法核對，於是改為交付一份任何人用 Node 就能驗的 Ed25519 簽名；並逐條把「文檔說的」與「實測到的」差量寫出來
e.summary: 一个建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的天气与风暴风险矿工，加一个编译成 WebAssembly 的评分模块，加一条以链上任务结算的参数化保险应用：其出发点是一句很硬的判断——网络自报的「已核实」从外部无法被核对，因此它改为对合约据以结算的字段逐一签名（Ed25519），并把公钥公布在 .well-known 路径下，使任何人都能用一条 Node 命令自行验证；其判词逐字为「Signed, not verified」；评分模块是一个 15.5 KB、零导入的 no_std Rust 程序，只做加减乘除与比较（IEEE-754 精确定义，故两台验证者返回完全相同的位），并从答案里读出量纲相同的数值来评分，另外两条规则承担大部分反作弊工作——问题里已经说过的数字再出现不得分，以及「押注胜过罗列」；仓库同时逐条公布自己实测到的网络现状与文档不符之处，包括评分模块比较文本而矿工回答数字、代币轨道长期闲置（341 个注册矿工对 14 个任务，其中 8 个是它自己的）、四分之三的活跃矿工无法接收任务，以及「64 中的 43 这个 BFT 门槛是主网属性、不是今天在跑的东西」
e.summary_hk: 一個建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的天氣與風暴風險礦工，加一個編譯成 WebAssembly 的評分模組，加一條以鏈上任務結算的參數化保險應用：其出發點是一句很硬的判斷——網絡自報的「已核實」從外部無法被核對，因此它改為對合約據以結算的字段逐一簽名（Ed25519），並把公鑰公佈在 .well-known 路徑下，使任何人都能用一條 Node 命令自行驗證；其判詞逐字為「Signed, not verified」；評分模組是一個 15.5 KB、零導入的 no_std Rust 程序，只做加減乘除與比較（IEEE-754 精確定義，故兩台驗證者返回完全相同的位），並從答案裡讀出量綱相同的數值來評分，另外兩條規則承擔大部分反作弊工作——問題裡已經說過的數字再出現不得分，以及「押注勝過羅列」；倉庫同時逐條公佈自己實測到的網絡現狀與文檔不符之處，包括評分模組比較文本而礦工回答數字、代幣軌道長期閒置（341 個註冊礦工對 14 個任務，其中 8 個是它自己的）、四分之三的活躍礦工無法接收任務，以及「64 中的 43 這個 BFT 門檻是主網屬性、不是今天在跑的東西」
e.summary_en: A weather and storm-risk miner on Telegraph Protocol, a scoring module compiled to WebAssembly, and a parametric insurance application settled through on-chain jobs: its starting point is a hard judgement — the network’s self-reported "verified" cannot be checked from outside — so it signs the fields a contract settles on individually with Ed25519 and publishes the key at a .well-known path, letting anyone verify with a single Node command; its verdict reads verbatim as "Signed, not verified"; the scoring module is a 15.5 KB no_std Rust program with zero imports that performs only addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and comparison (exactly defined by IEEE-754, so two validators on different hosts return identical bits) and scores answers by reading same-dimension quantities out of them, with two further rules carrying most of the anti-gaming work — a number the question already stated earns nothing when it comes back, and committing beats covering; and the repository writes out its own measurements of where the network diverges from its documentation, including that scoring modules compare text while miners answer with numbers, that the on-chain rail sits idle (341 miner registrations against 14 jobs, eight of them its own), that three quarters of live miners cannot receive a job at all, and that the 43-of-64 BFT threshold is a mainnet property rather than something running today
e.body:
**amanat-telegraph-miner**（Amanat，仓库 `PugarHuda/amanat`）**是一个建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的**天气与风暴风险矿工**，加一个编译成 WebAssembly 的**评分模块**，加一条以链上任务结算的**参数化保险应用****：**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **MIT**（`LICENSE` 实测存在）、主语言 JavaScript、仓库体量 42,353 KB、创建于 2026-08-21、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）；**topics 实测为** `ai-agents`、`base-sepolia`、`erc-8183`、`mcp`、`model-context-protocol`、`openapi`、`oracle`、`parametric-insurance`、`smart-contracts`、`storm-risk`、`telegraph-protocol`、`wasm`、`weather`、`x402`；**README 实测 **48,267 字节**（英语）**；**仓库实测共 489 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「**Signed weather intelligence that a contract acts on by itself.**」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「只报别人能重算的数」**中的**第一种，也是四条里唯一**把网络自报的布尔值换成可外部重算的签名**的一条**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇就是本轮主题最纯粹的表述，且它点名的是一个**具体的、别人系统里的**布尔值****——**逐字为**：**「**Signed*, not "verified": the network’s own `verified: true` **cannot be checked from outside** ([bug report](docs/bug-report.md#a-signal-commitment-that-cannot-be-re-derived)), so **every answer here carries an Ed25519 signature over the fields a contract settles on, and anyone can check it with Node and nothing else**:」**，**随后逐字给出那条命令**（**一条 `node -e` 单行，从接口取回 attestation，用 `crypto.verify` 对着它自带的公钥验 `canonical` 上的签名**）**——**并逐字补充**：**「The key it checks against is the one published at [`/.well-known/amanat.json`]」**⭐⭐⭐ **四件事合起来构成一条完整的可外包复核链**：**① 它指出网络自报的 `verified: true` **从外部不可核对**；**② 它把**合约据以结算的字段**（而不是整个响应）拿去签名；**③ 它把验签所需的一切（公钥、canonical 串、签名）都放进响应，并把公钥另公布在 `.well-known` 路径**；**④ 它把验证压缩到**一条不需要任何依赖的命令****——**⭐ 而它另有一份 `docs/bug-report.md`**（**实测存在**），**其锚点逐字为 `#a-signal-commitment-that-cannot-be-re-derived`**（**「一个无法被重新导出的信号承诺」**）**⭐⭐ 即**它不只绕过这个缺陷，还把它作为缺陷记录了下来****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其 Track 2 评分模块是全条最值得本行细读的部分，因为它把「评分」变成了一件**量纲工作****——**逐字为**：**「`scorer/` is a `no_std` Rust module compiled to `wasm32-unknown-unknown`: **15.5 KB, zero imports**, exporting `alloc`, `dealloc`, `rank_answer` and `breakdown_answer`.」**；**「It reads the *quantities* out of an answer and grades them as measurements: **`38.2 °C`, `100.8 F` and `311.35 K` are one reading**; `10 m/s` and `36 km/h` are one wind speed; **being 0.3° out is right and 30° out is wrong**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① **零导入、15.5 KB、`no_std`**——**体积与依赖被压到极小，便于作为 WASM 在任何节点上确定性执行**；**② **温度与风速的等价换算**——**「38.2 °C／100.8 F／311.35 K 是同一个读数」**——**即评分先做**单位归一化**，再判对错****（**⭐ 对本行读者：**这正是精算与工程里**最常见的静默错误**之一——**12 °C 与 12 毫米**在纯文本比较下看不出区别**，**而该仓库后文恰好点名了一个因此出错的冠军模块**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其两条反作弊规则各自针对一种**看起来像答案的东西****——**逐字为**：**「**A number the question already stated earns nothing when it comes back.** "Will it exceed 40 °C?" answered with "40 °C" is the prompt, not a reading — unless the ground truth also says 40.」**；**「**Committing beats covering.** Listing every candidate value is charged for, so **a hedged answer cannot outscore a decision**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **第一条封的是**复述问题**，第二条封的是**罗列所有可能值**（**即**押注式回答**）**——**⭐ 对做模型评测或智能体评分的同学，这两条是**很具体的反刷分设计**（**可与本站 [[insqabench]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] 并读**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其确定性来源逐字，且理由是本行会欣赏的那一类**——**逐字为**：**「Every float operation is `+ - * /` and comparison, **which IEEE-754 defines exactly, so two validators on different hosts return identical bits**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**把浮点运算限制在 IEEE-754 **精确定义**的那几种上，**从而使**两台主机上的验证者返回完全相同的位****——**⭐ 这与第 336 轮 [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 的「金额只用整数、费率只用基点、任何地方都没有浮点数」是**同一目标的两条路径**：**那一条用整数回避浮点，这一条用**受限的浮点子集**取得确定性**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其基准表最值得记的不是自己那一行，而是它对**赢了自己的那一行**的处理**——**逐字为**：**「The top row is the one to read first: **registration 1265, the module that took the `GAME_RESULT` slot back off us after forty minutes, beats this module on this corpus. It is a good module.** The three seated on the weather intents are not, and that is the gap this project is about.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**它主动指出**把自己挤下去的那个模块**、**称之为「一个好模块」**、**并说明被它取代的时间是「四十分钟后」****——**⭐ 对做评测的同学，这是一处**关于如何报告「我输了」的样本**；**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**这些基准数字**（**见标注 ③**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **「仓库替你做不了的那一步」逐字，且它把原因与重建方法都写了**——**逐字为**：**「**Reproducing this table needs one step the repo cannot do for you.** `scorer/champions/*.wasm` **is gitignored** — **they are other people’s binaries, some of them 25 MB** — so **a clean clone has nothing to compare against and `npm run bench` will report only our own**. Fetch them first from the `wasm_url` each registration publishes at … and drop them in `scorer/champions/`.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**干净克隆跑不出那张表，因为对手的二进制是他人的、且有的 25 MB，故不入库；**重建方法是**从每个注册公布的 `wasm_url` 自行抓取****——**⭐ 这正是本轮主题的核心形态之一：**它说清**哪些数字需要你自己动手才能重算、以及怎么做****（**⚠️ 本词条**未抓取任何 champion 二进制、未运行 `npm run bench`**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **其对自己语料的界定也有两处限定**——**逐字为**：**「**Read the rest honestly: this corpus is ours, and it says the approach works on the cases we can see, not that it wins the protocol’s own hidden fixtures.**」**；**以及**：**「**Widening the corpus from 20 cases to 38 is what found the real bugs.**」**（**随后逐条列出三个真实 bug**：**「812.4 million」被解析成 812.4 而「812.4M」解析正确**；**一个省略了数字的**正确改写**得分**低于**一个引用了该数字的**错误答案**；**以及「not a human」在 AI 检测题上被读成了负面判定**）**——**并逐字给出结论**：**「**Each of those was a wrong rule, not a missing special case.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「每一个都是**规则错了**，而不是**少了一个特例****」是一句值得单独记住的工程判断**（**⭐ 可与第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 的「六个模型五败一胜」并读：两处都在**把失败归类到正确的层级**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **「没人谈的那道门」一节揭示了评测之外的**第二道门槛**，且给了一个很具体的反差**——**逐字为**：**「**### The gate nobody talks about** — Beating the champion’s margin is not sufficient on an intent that carries traffic: **the node also checks that your module orders *real* miner answers roughly the way the champion does, and rejects below about 0.60**. **That is why a 0.68-margin module was refused on `WEB_SEARCH` while a 0.388 one went live.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**在流量意图上，**指标赢了还不够，还要与现任冠军的排序足够一致（低于约 0.60 即拒）****——**⭐ 这解释了「一个 0.68 的模块在网页搜索上被拒，而一个 0.388 的上线了」**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**该门槛阈值与其实现**）。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **其反作弊与「真实信号」的判据逐字**：**「**Anti-gaming: 14/14 attacks held.**」**；**并逐字说明最后一条为何需要第三个信号**：**「A negator flips the next verdict word inside its own clause, so "no malicious behaviour" reads positive, while "**No,** it is a phishing page" is itself the verdict because a clause break ends the negator’s reach. **An answer that commits the other way from the ground truth keeps 15% of its score, however much of the right vocabulary it carries.**」**⭐⭐ **并逐字给出这一改动**同时**带来的两个结果**：**「That closed the keyword dump (**0.84 to 0.13 against an honest 0.53**) and raised the benchmark margin at the same time, **which is the shape of a real signal rather than a patch**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「这是一个**真信号**的形状，而不是一个补丁」**——**即**判据是**关掉作弊的同时指标也上升**，**而不是**只顾一头****。**⑩ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「网络实际长什么样」一节是本条第二个主题支柱：它逐条对比**文档说的**与**实测到的****——**逐字实测**：**「**Deterministic intents are scored as if they were prose.** In epoch 240 the rank-1 miner on `WEATHER_CHECK` scored **0.0206** and on `STORM_ALERT` **0.0067**. **The miners are not bad; every scoring module on the network compares text, and those miners answer with numbers. A leaderboard built from those scores is noise — and routing follows the leaderboard.**」**；**「epochs run **hourly** on testnet, **not the 24 hours the docs describe**.」**；**「each one scores 70 results across 17 intents and **29 of the 66 registered miners** — **more than half are never scored at all**.」**；**「**There is one active validator** … so **the 43-of-64 BFT threshold is a mainnet property, not something running today**.」**；**「**The shape held; the size did not.**」****⭐⭐⭐ **四处各是一种**文档与实测的差****：**① **排名是噪声**——**因为评分比较文本、而矿工回答数字**，**而**路由跟着排名走****；**② **epoch 实际是每小时而非文档说的 24 小时**；**③ **超过一半的注册矿工从未被打分**；**④ **只有一个活跃验证者**，**故**「64 中的 43」是主网属性、不是今天在跑的****（**⭐ 第 ④ 条对本行读者尤其值得记：**一个门槛写在文档里，与它今天是否被满足，是两件事****）。**⑪ ⭐⭐ **它对**链上轨道闲置**的量化同样是自陈的，且包含对自己份额的核算**——**逐字为**：**「the Diamond … carried **139 miner registrations** against **6 ERC-8183 jobs in its entire lifetime**」**；**「Read again on 31 August: **341 miner registrations, and still only 14 jobs. Eight of the fourteen are ours. Five settled; the last three have not moved.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「十四个里有八个是我们的」是一句很少见的自我披露****——**⚠️ 且**「最后三个还没动」也一并写出****。**⑫ ⭐⭐⭐ **其第三个问题指出了一条**很具体的接入瓶颈**，并给出可复现的审计命令**——**逐字为**：**「A job hands the node raw `OnChainData` arrays; **without an `on_chain.request` block in its YAML the node cannot turn those into an HTTP call**. `npm run audit` fetches every registered YAML and checks. On 31 August: of **125 live miners, 29 declare an `on_chain` block at all**, and a name-hashable intent has between one and three job-able miners — **`STORM_ALERT` has exactly one, and it is this one**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「`STORM_ALERT` 恰好只有一个，而它就是这一个」**——**⭐ 这句话同时解释了第 337 轮 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] 为何必须自己造矿工**（**⚠️ 本词条**未运行 `npm run audit`**）。**⑬ ⭐⭐ **其第三个主题支柱是一次**有代价的现场发现**，且同一类失败在第 337 轮出现过**——**逐字为**：**「Policy 2 was written at latitude `1` and policy 3 at `10.32`. **Both came back risk 0.382, forecast for `0.00, 0.00`.** The contract stored the coordinates correctly and passed them in `strings[0..1]`; the YAML maps them from `strings.0` and `strings.1`. **They do not survive the node’s `on_chain.request` mapping.**」**；**「On job 9 it changed the outcome. The Engine screen for Manila read risk **0.488**, above the escalation threshold; **the job opened for that same policy came back 0.361, the value for Null Island**, and the contract declined the claim. **A contract that paid a dollar for a signal acted on a reading of somewhere else.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「一个花了**一美元**买信号的合约，据以行动的却是**别处**的读数」**——**⭐ 与本轮主题相合：**一条**成功返回**的信号，其内容指向的却是另一个地方****；**⭐ 而它之所以被发现，是因为**两条不同纬度的保单返回了完全相同的值****（**即可疑之处不是任何一条单独的信号，而是**两条信号之间的一致**）。**⑭ ⭐⭐ **其两处「花一笔交易才学到的事」对本行读者也很实在**：**「`createJob` draws on the escrow of **whoever calls it** — the contract, not the wallet that deployed it」**；**以及** **「**The public Base Sepolia RPC serves its own writes back stale.** A confirmed transfer read as a zero balance, a confirmed `approve` simulated as `exceeds allowance`, and a `requestCheck` that reverted on `estimateGas` while the same call returned `jobId 7` when simulated directly one command later.」**⭐⭐⭐ **第二条指出的是一类**很值得记住的失败**：**一个权威来源（公共 RPC）把**已确认的写入**读成了旧值**——**⭐ 即**「刚写完就读」这件事本身不可靠****。**⑮ ⭐ **其复现命令逐字且分成了**花钱与不花钱两档****——**逐字含** `npm run agent:dry`（**注释逐字**「the loop, read-only, **spends nothing**」）、`npm run survey`（「the scoring board: **measured bar vs displayed score**, free」）、`npm run audit`（「**which intents an on-chain job cannot survive**, free」）、`npm run impact`（「what changed on any intent our module scores, free」）、`npm run expire`（**gas only**）、`npm run build:profiles`（**「ten binaries, **fails if any two match**」**）**⭐⭐ **其中两处值得记**：**① **「measured bar vs displayed score」**——**即**有一条免费命令专门用来对照**实测门槛**与**显示分数****（**⭐ 本轮的又一处「自报的数 vs 可重算的数」**）；**② **「十个二进制，任意两个相同即失败」**——**即**构建会验证**十个 profile 确实互不相同****。**⑯ ⭐ **另有两处可核实细节**：**其合约地址经 **Sourcify 验证**，**创建期与运行期字节码**均为完整匹配**（**README 逐字**「creation and runtime bytecode both a full match, so what the chain runs is what this repo shows」），**且**旧部署被替换而非留在原地**，**理由是逐字**「**the tests only prove the code in this repo, and a deployment running different code from the one under test is the sort of gap this project keeps finding in other people’s systems**」**；**其三个轨道**按**由便宜到贵**排序（**免费守护进程 / x402 引擎调用 0.01 美元 / 一个任务 1.00 美元**），**逐字理由为** **「the agent asks a hundred cheap questions before it asks one expensive one」**（**一次运行逐字为「42 paid Engine calls, one escalation, $1.42」**）**⭐⭐⭐ **「用与仓库同一份代码的部署」这一条尤其值得记**：**字节码级验证使**链上在跑的**与**仓库里显示的**是同一个东西****。**⑰ ⭐ 可与本站保险评测、智能体评测、参数化险与验证条目并读**：[[storm-parametric-corroboration]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[insqabench]]、[[agentbench]]、[[acteval]]、[[actuarial-math-bench]]、[[proof-protocol]]、[[reliability-harness]]、[[finproof-bench]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]。

**amanat-telegraph-miner**（Amanat，倉庫 `PugarHuda/amanat`）**是一個建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的**天氣與風暴風險礦工**，加一個編譯成 WebAssembly 的**評分模組**，加一條以鏈上任務結算的**參數化保險應用****：**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **MIT**（`LICENSE` 實測存在）、主語言 JavaScript、體量 42,353 KB、創建於 2026-08-21、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**均落在解凍窗口之後**）；**topics 實測 14 個**（含 `parametric-insurance`、`storm-risk`、`wasm`、`x402`、`erc-8183` 等）；**README 實測 **48,267 位元組**（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 489 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「**Signed weather intelligence that a contract acts on by itself.**」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「只報別人能重算的數」**中的**第一種，也是四條裡唯一**把網絡自報的布爾值換成可外部重算的簽名**的一條**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其開篇就是本輪主題最純粹的表述，且它點名的是一個**具體的、別人系統裡的**布爾值****——**逐字為**：**「**Signed*, not "verified": the network’s own `verified: true` **cannot be checked from outside**, so **every answer here carries an Ed25519 signature over the fields a contract settles on, and anyone can check it with Node and nothing else**」**，**隨後逐字給出那條 `node -e` 單行命令**（**從接口取回 attestation，用 `crypto.verify` 對著它自帶的公鑰驗 `canonical` 上的簽名**）**，**並逐字補充** **「The key it checks against is the one published at [`/.well-known/amanat.json`]」**⭐⭐⭐ **四件事合起來構成完整的可外包複核鏈**：**① 它指出網絡自報的 `verified: true` 從外部不可核對**；**② 它把**合約據以結算的字段**（而非整個響應）拿去簽名**；**③ 驗簽所需的一切都在響應裡，且公鑰另公佈在 `.well-known` 路徑**；**④ 驗證被壓縮到**一條不需要任何依賴的命令****——**⭐ 而它另有一份 `docs/bug-report.md`**（**實測存在**），**其錨點逐字為 `#a-signal-commitment-that-cannot-be-re-derived`**（**「一個無法被重新導出的信號承諾」**）**⭐⭐ 即**它不只繞過這個缺陷，還把它作為缺陷記錄了下來****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **Track 2 評分模組最值得本行細讀，因為它把「評分」變成了一件**量綱工作****——**逐字**：**「`scorer/` is a `no_std` Rust module compiled to `wasm32-unknown-unknown`: **15.5 KB, zero imports**, exporting `alloc`, `dealloc`, `rank_answer` and `breakdown_answer`.」**；**「It reads the *quantities* out of an answer and grades them as measurements: **`38.2 °C`, `100.8 F` and `311.35 K` are one reading**; `10 m/s` and `36 km/h` are one wind speed; **being 0.3° out is right and 30° out is wrong**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩處值得記**：**① **零導入、15.5 KB、`no_std`**——**體積與依賴被壓到極小，便於作為 WASM 在任何節點上確定性執行**；**② **溫度與風速的等價換算**——**即評分先做**單位歸一化**再判對錯****（**⭐ 對本行讀者：**這正是精算與工程裡**最常見的靜默錯誤**之一——**12 °C 與 12 毫米**在純文本比較下看不出區別**，而該倉庫後文恰好點名了一個因此出錯的冠軍模組**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **兩條反作弊規則各針對一種**看起來像答案的東西****——**逐字**：**「**A number the question already stated earns nothing when it comes back.** "Will it exceed 40 °C?" answered with "40 °C" is the prompt, not a reading — unless the ground truth also says 40.」**；**「**Committing beats covering.** Listing every candidate value is charged for, so **a hedged answer cannot outscore a decision**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **第一條封的是**複述問題**，第二條封的是**羅列所有可能值（押注式回答）****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其確定性來源逐字**：**「Every float operation is `+ - * /` and comparison, **which IEEE-754 defines exactly, so two validators on different hosts return identical bits**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**把浮點運算限制在 IEEE-754 精確定義的那幾種上****——**⭐ 與第 336 輪 [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 的「金額只用整數、費率只用基點、任何地方都沒有浮點數」是**同一目標的兩條路徑**：**那條用整數迴避浮點，這條用**受限的浮點子集**取得確定性**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其基準表最值得記的不是自己那一行，而是它對**贏了自己的那一行**的處理**——**逐字**：**「The top row is the one to read first: **registration 1265, the module that took the `GAME_RESULT` slot back off us after forty minutes, beats this module on this corpus. It is a good module.** The three seated on the weather intents are not, and that is the gap this project is about.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**它主動指出把自己擠下去的那個模組、**稱之為「一個好模組」**、**並說明取代發生在「四十分鐘後」****——**⭐ 這是一處**關於如何報告「我輸了」的樣本****。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **「倉庫替你做不了的那一步」逐字**：**「**Reproducing this table needs one step the repo cannot do for you.** `scorer/champions/*.wasm` **is gitignored** — **they are other people’s binaries, some of them 25 MB** — so **a clean clone has nothing to compare against and `npm run bench` will report only our own**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**乾淨克隆跑不出那張表，因為對手的二進制是他人的、有的 25 MB，故不入庫；**重建方法是**從每個註冊公佈的 `wasm_url` 自行抓取****——**⭐ 這正是本輪主題的核心形態之一：**它說清**哪些數字需要你自己動手才能重算、以及怎麼做****。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **其對自己語料的界定有兩處限定**：**「**Read the rest honestly: this corpus is ours, and it says the approach works on the cases we can see, not that it wins the protocol’s own hidden fixtures.**」**；**「**Widening the corpus from 20 cases to 38 is what found the real bugs.**」**（**隨後逐條列出三個真實 bug**：**「812.4 million」被解析成 812.4 而「812.4M」解析正確**；**一個省略了數字的**正確改寫**得分**低於**一個引用了該數字的**錯誤答案**；**「not a human」在 AI 檢測題上被讀成負面判定**）**——**並逐字給出結論**：**「**Each of those was a wrong rule, not a missing special case.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「每一個都是**規則錯了**，而不是**少了一個特例****」值得單獨記住**（**⭐ 可與第 336 輪 [[inforsight]] 的「六個模型五敗一勝」並讀：兩處都在**把失敗歸類到正確的層級**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **「沒人談的那道門」揭示了評測之外的**第二道門檻****——**逐字**：**「**### The gate nobody talks about** — Beating the champion’s margin is not sufficient on an intent that carries traffic: **the node also checks that your module orders *real* miner answers roughly the way the champion does, and rejects below about 0.60**. **That is why a 0.68-margin module was refused on `WEB_SEARCH` while a 0.388 one went live.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即在流量意圖上，指標贏了還不夠，還要與現任冠軍的排序足夠一致（低於約 0.60 即拒）****。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **反作弊與「真實信號」的判據逐字**：**「**Anti-gaming: 14/14 attacks held.**」**；**「A negator flips the next verdict word inside its own clause … **An answer that commits the other way from the ground truth keeps 15% of its score, however much of the right vocabulary it carries.**」**；**「That closed the keyword dump (**0.84 to 0.13 against an honest 0.53**) and raised the benchmark margin at the same time, **which is the shape of a real signal rather than a patch**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「這是一個**真信號**的形狀，而不是一個補丁」——**即**判據是**關掉作弊的同時指標也上升****。**⑩ ⭐⭐⭐ **「網絡實際長什麼樣」是本條第二個主題支柱：逐條對比**文檔說的**與**實測到的****——**逐字實測**：**「**Deterministic intents are scored as if they were prose.** In epoch 240 the rank-1 miner on `WEATHER_CHECK` scored **0.0206** and on `STORM_ALERT` **0.0067**. **The miners are not bad; every scoring module on the network compares text, and those miners answer with numbers. A leaderboard built from those scores is noise — and routing follows the leaderboard.**」**；**「epochs run **hourly** on testnet, **not the 24 hours the docs describe**.」**；**「each one scores 70 results across 17 intents and **29 of the 66 registered miners** — **more than half are never scored at all**.」**；**「**There is one active validator** … so **the 43-of-64 BFT threshold is a mainnet property, not something running today**.」**；**「**The shape held; the size did not.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處各是一種**文檔與實測的差****：**① 排名是噪聲（評分比較文本、礦工回答數字，而路由跟著排名走）**；**② epoch 實際每小時而非文檔說的 24 小時**；**③ 超過一半註冊礦工從未被打分**；**④ 只有一個活躍驗證者，故「64 中的 43」是主網屬性、不是今天在跑的****（**⭐ 第 ④ 條尤其值得記：**一個門檻寫在文檔裡，與它今天是否被滿足，是兩件事****）。**⑪ ⭐⭐ **對**鏈上軌道閒置**的量化同樣自陳，且包含對自己份額的核算**：**「the Diamond … carried **139 miner registrations** against **6 ERC-8183 jobs in its entire lifetime**」**；**「Read again on 31 August: **341 miner registrations, and still only 14 jobs. Eight of the fourteen are ours. Five settled; the last three have not moved.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「十四個裡有八個是我們的」是一句很少見的自我披露****（**⚠️ 且「最後三個還沒動」也一併寫出**）。**⑫ ⭐⭐⭐ **第三個問題指出一條**具體的接入瓶頸**並給出可複現的審計命令**：**「without an `on_chain.request` block in its YAML the node cannot turn those into an HTTP call. `npm run audit` fetches every registered YAML and checks. On 31 August: of **125 live miners, 29 declare an `on_chain` block at all** … **`STORM_ALERT` has exactly one, and it is this one**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「`STORM_ALERT` 恰好只有一個，而它就是這一個」**——**⭐ 這句話同時解釋了第 337 輪 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] 為何必須自己造礦工**（**⚠️ 未運行 `npm run audit`**）。**⑬ ⭐⭐ **第三個支柱是一次**有代價的現場發現**，且同類失敗在第 337 輪出現過**：**「Policy 2 was written at latitude `1` and policy 3 at `10.32`. **Both came back risk 0.382, forecast for `0.00, 0.00`.** … **They do not survive the node’s `on_chain.request` mapping.**」**；**「On job 9 it changed the outcome. The Engine screen for Manila read risk **0.488** … **the job opened for that same policy came back 0.361, the value for Null Island**, and the contract declined the claim. **A contract that paid a dollar for a signal acted on a reading of somewhere else.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「一個花了**一美元**買信號的合約，據以行動的卻是**別處**的讀數」**——**⭐ 而它之所以被發現，是因為**兩條不同緯度的保單返回了完全相同的值****（**即可疑之處不是任何一條單獨的信號，而是**兩條信號之間的一致**）。**⑭ ⭐⭐ confirmed transfer read as a zero balance, a confirmed `approve` simulated as `exceeds allowance` …」**⭐⭐⭐ **第二條指出的是一類值得記住的失敗：**一個權威來源把**已確認的寫入**讀成了舊值****。**⑮ ⭐ **復現命令分成**花錢與不花錢兩檔****——**逐字含** `npm run **it signs the fields a contract settles on rather than the whole response**; **everything needed to verify travels in the response, with the key also published at a .well-known path**; **and verification is compressed into one command needing no dependencies** — ⭐ **and a `docs/bug-report.md` also exists** (**measurably present**), **whose anchor reads verbatim `#a-signal-commitment-that-cannot-be-re-derived`** ⭐⭐ **so it does not merely route around the defect, it records it as a defect**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Track 2, the scoring module, is the part this field should read most closely, because it turns scoring into dimensional work** — **verbatim**: **"`scorer/` is a `no_std` Rust module compiled to `wasm32-unknown-unknown`: **15.5 KB, zero imports**, exporting `alloc`, `dealloc`, `rank_answer` and `breakdown_answer`."**; **and the temperature and wind-speed equivalences mean scoring normalises units before judging** — ⭐ **and this is one of the most common silent errors in this field: "12 °C" and "12 millimetres" are indistinguishable under plain text comparison, and the repository later names a champion module that fails on exactly that**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its two anti-gaming rules each close off something that looks like an answer** — **verbatim**: **"**A number the question already stated earns nothing when it comes back.** "Will it exceed 40 °C?" answered with "40 °C" is the prompt, not a reading — unless the ground truth also says 40."**; It is a good module.** The three seated on the weather intents are not, and that is the gap this project is about."** ⭐⭐⭐ **it names the module that displaced it, calls it a good module, and records that the displacement took forty minutes** — ⭐ **a sample of how to report losing**. **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ "The step the repo cannot do for you" is verbatim**: **"**Reproducing this table needs one step the repo cannot do for you.** `scorer/champions/*.wasm` **is gitignored** — **they are other people’s binaries, some of them 25 MB** — so **a clean clone has nothing to compare against and `npm run bench` will report only our own**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **a clean clone cannot reproduce that table, because the opponents’ binaries are other people’s and some are 25 MB, so they are not committed;
